name: Artist Profile
summary: Named, container-responsive artist biography with optional portrait, quotation, and canonical action composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native artist-profile section named by its visible artist heading and establishing the inline-size container.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Internal container-responsive layout that preserves portrait-before-content source order.

anatomy.name: portrait
anatomy.description: Optional passive artist portrait media region, omitted completely when no portrait is supplied.

anatomy.name: portraitImage
anatomy.description: Native portrait image supplied by the target with context-appropriate alternative text.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional ordinary action group composed from canonical Button or other target-owned native controls; it is not a navigation landmark.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single-column layout that becomes two columns when the component content container is wide enough.

states.name: default
states.description: Required name and biography content with any accepted optional parts.

states.name: withPortrait
states.description: Explicit portrait-present composition that becomes a two-column media/content split in a wide component container. Adapters omit the modifier with the optional portrait.

behavior.name: narrativeOrder
behavior.description: Adapters should preserve label, name, location, biography, philosophy, and action reading order independently of the visual columns.

behavior.name: sectionLabelling
behavior.description: The native section references a target-unique id on the visible artist-name heading; heading rank remains owned by the surrounding document.

behavior.name: portraitAlternative
behavior.description: The target supplies useful alternative text for informative portraits or an empty alternative for decorative media and omits the entire portrait region when absent.

behavior.name: optionalContent
behavior.description: Optional parts are omitted without empty shells, placeholder controls, or changes to the required name/biography order.

behavior.name: containerComposition
behavior.description: The root establishes an isolated inline-size container; the internal layout stacks in narrow containers, splits media/content in wide containers only with its portrait-present modifier, and remains one column when portrait is absent.

behavior.name: quotationSemantics
behavior.description: Philosophy content uses a native blockquote only when it is an actual quotation; citation metadata remains target-authored when needed.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: The group adds no landmark or composite-widget semantics. Canonical Button or target-native links/buttons own href, activation, focus, disabled, busy, hover and pressed behavior.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Rich, localized and unbroken content wraps inside the actual container; actions wrap as a group without viewport overflow.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Artist Profile owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, live region, focus movement or animation. Data, rich-text safety, media loading and routing remain target responsibilities.

properties.name: portrait
properties.description: Target-owned passive portrait media with informative or decorative native alternative text as context requires.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional editorial label shown before the artist name.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Artist display name rendered as the visible section heading; its contextual native heading level remains target-owned.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional target-owned calls to action; canonical Button or target-native controls retain their own semantics and destinations.

accessibility: Associate the native section with the visible artist-name heading through a target-unique aria-labelledby/id pair.
Use a native heading level appropriate to the surrounding document; the visual class does not mandate h2.
Give informative portrait media concise useful alternative text, use alt="" when it is decorative, and omit the portrait region when absent.
Preserve portrait-before-content and authored narrative source order when the layout changes between one and two columns.
Use blockquote only for content quoted from the artist and keep any source or citation target-authored.
Keep the action group out of the landmark list and preserve native keyboard semantics and visible focus from every composed Button or link.
Allow localized, unbroken, rich and zoomed content to reflow without horizontal viewport overflow.
Do not add Artist Profile widget roles, custom keyboard handling, focus movement, live announcements or motion.

shopify.notes: Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps image, identity, biography, quotation and one canonical Button destination without neutral runtime.
